judgements.justification: All four B reviewers held the analysis paper to a design-guidance test that A never applied; A's Reviewer_qxEj instead praised it as likely to inspire new architectures.
B's below-threshold scores held after the rebuttal (16Eb at 4, fR12 at 5) rest on design utility, novelty and the one-CNN-family limit, which are central to an analysis paper, not peripheral points.
